info.name: Learnova LMS API
info.description:
## Learnova LMS API

This collection covers the core REST API endpoints for **Learnova**, a Learning Management System (LMS). It is organized into three functional areas — Authentication, User Management, and Course Management — and targets a backend running at `http://localhost:8080`.

### Folders

**Authentication**
Handles session-related operations for authenticated users:
- `Get current user` — Retrieves the profile of the currently logged-in user
- `Logout` — Terminates the active user session

**Users**
Provides full lifecycle management for user accounts:
- `Create user` — Registers a new user in the system
- `Get users` — Returns a list of all users
- `Get user by ID` — Fetches a specific user's details
- `Enable user` — Reactivates a previously disabled account
- `Disable user` — Suspends a user account
- `Soft delete user` — Marks a user as deleted without permanently removing them

**Courses**
Manages the course catalog available on the platform:
- `Get courses` — Lists all available courses
- `Get course by ID` — Retrieves details for a specific course
- `Create course` — Adds a new course to the catalog
- `Update course` — Modifies an existing course's information
- `Delete course` — Removes a course from the catalog

### Collection variables
Key variables are pre-configured for convenience: `baseUrl`, `userId`, `courseId`, `courseName`, `courseDescription`, `coursePrice`, and `JSESSIONID` for session-based authentication.

item.description:
## Authentication

This folder handles session and authentication management for the Learnova LMS API. The backend uses OAuth2 with Keycloak via the BFF (Backend for Frontend) pattern, meaning authentication state is managed server-side through secure session cookies.

### Requests

- **Get current user** — Retrieves the profile and session information of the currently authenticated user. Useful for verifying that a valid session is active and for fetching identity details (e.g., roles, username) after login.

- **Logout** — Terminates the current user session by invalidating the server-side session and revoking the associated Keycloak tokens. After a successful logout, subsequent requests requiring authentication will be rejected until the user logs in again.

item.description:
Endpoints for managing user accounts within the Learnova LMS platform. This folder covers the full lifecycle of a user, including:

- **Create user** – Register a new user in the system.
    
- **Get users** – Retrieve a paginated list of all users.
    
- **Get user by ID** – Fetch the details of a specific user.
    
- **Enable user** – Reactivate a previously disabled user account.
    
- **Disable user** – Temporarily deactivate a user account without removing it.
    
- **Soft delete user** – Mark a user as deleted while preserving their data in the system.

item.name: Courses
item.description:
Endpoints for managing courses within the Learnova LMS platform. This folder covers the full lifecycle of a course resource, including:

- **List courses** – retrieve all available courses (`GET /api/courses`)
- **Get course by ID** – fetch the details of a specific course (`GET /api/courses/:courseId`)
- **Create course** – add a new course to the platform (`POST /api/courses`)
- **Update course** – partially modify an existing course (`PATCH /api/courses/:courseId`)
- **Delete course** – remove a course from the system (`DELETE /api/courses/:courseId`)

The `{{courseId}}` collection variable is used to target a specific course across the relevant requests.
